note: Seeded chip-timing prior. 'planned' rows are a pre-season survey of manager intent and are the strongest evidence available before a ball is kicked. 'expert' rows are published recommendations. Nothing here is 'observed' yet — that kind only exists once a season has been played, and it outranks everything below when it arrives. Second-half rows are explicitly lower confidence: the doubles and blanks that drive them are created by cup progression during the season and cannot be known in August.
